clusters.title: India’s infra output jumps 7.9% in Sept
clusters.description: India's infrastructure output jumped 7.9% in September on a year-on-year basis, government data showed on Wednesday, reflecting strong growth in coal, refinery products, steel and iron ore.The core sector output rose as compared with 3.1% growth in the same month last year, according to the data .The index, which tracks activity across nine sectors and makes up about a third of the country's industrial production, rose at a revised 5.9% in August. The data covers nine key infrastructure sectors under the revamped Index of Core Industries (ICI), which uses 2022-23 as the base year and includes iron ore as the ninth sector. The new series replaced the earlier 2011-12-based series.
